misprints.note: πάγος is masculine; the print gives the article τό.
The print clearly shows τὶ, not τό.
The third ἑαυτῷ has no visible iota subscript, though the two before it do.
The abbreviation has no full stop, just a gap before the parenthesis. Transcribed without the stop.

uncertain.note: The scan cuts off at ἡ at the right edge. I supplied the full stop, but it could not be seen.
uttr runs into the cut-off right edge. I supplied the full stop.
The final ὁ is at the cut-off edge. I supplied the full stop.

uncertain.text: κριθῶν, ῶντος / οῦσα, οῦν / οῦ, ὁ
uncertain.note: These endings show only a circumflex and no breathing, so I wrote them that way. Other strips of the book use οὖσα, οὖν.
On the first α the breathing mark slopes like a grave accent. I read it as a badly formed smooth breathing (ἀ).
In the printed line 'κην. ηρωικως' the accents have slipped down onto the line above. I put back rough breathing, diaeresis and circumflex.
